# Mindorion

> Mindorion helps B2B teams protect their professional reputation by controlling documents, structuring outreach, and managing compliance before every external send.

Mindorion offers three products: ProposalIQ (document quality and metadata control), GrowthIQ (structured B2B outreach), and Governance Layer (compliance and governance for external communications).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Mindorion's professional intelligence platform.
- [About](/about): Company story, mission, and team.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans and pricing for all products.
- [Contact](/contact): Request a personalized demo.
- [Use cases](/use-cases): Real-world scenarios for B2B teams.
- [Security](/security): Security practices and certifications.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on document quality, outreach, and compliance.

## Products

- [ProposalIQ](/products/proposaliq): Document quality control and metadata cleanup.
- [GrowthIQ](/products/growthiq): Structured B2B prospecting and outreach.
- [Governance Layer](/products/governanceiq): Compliance and governance for external sends.
